headline: School Committee to review FY27 grant awards, school choice openings, staffing requests, and vaccination executive order impact.
summary: The Methuen School Committee will hear staff reports, review FY27 grant awards and budget updates, and discuss school choice openings, staffing requests, building conditions, and other committee business. The committee will also go into executive session to discuss litigation strategy in Methuen Education Association v. Methuen School Committee, MUP-26-11965.
